The '''2017–18 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team''' represented [[Duke University]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were coached by 38th-year head coach [[Mike Krzyzewski]]. The Blue Devils played their home games at [[Cameron Indoor Stadium]] in [[Durham, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 29–8, 13–5 in [[2017–18 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in second place. They defeated Notre Dame in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] before losing to North Carolina in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 2 seed in the Midwest region. There they defeated [[2017–18 Iona Gaels men's basketball team|Iona]], [[2017–18 Rhode Island Rams men's basketball team|Rhode Island]], and [[2017–18 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] to advance to the Elite Eight. In the Elite Eight, they lost to No. 1 seed [[2017–18 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] in overtime.

The 2017–18 Blue Devils team was one of the few teams in NCAA history to send their whole starting five pro in the off-season following their season.  Four of them were drafted (two in lottery, one late first round, one second round) and another was signed as an undrafted free agent. Throughout the season, the whole starting five were in first round NBA draft projections.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/2018-nba-draft-prospect-rankings-dukes-marvin-bagley-ahead-of-michael-porter/ | title=2018 NBA Draft prospect rankings: Duke's Marvin Bagley ahead of Michael Porter | first=Reid |last=Forgrave |work=CBSSports.com |date=December 8, 2017 |accessdate=April 1, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.balldurham.com/2018/01/03/where-will-the-blue-devils-be-drafted-in-2018/ |title=Where will the Blue Devils be Drafted in 2018? |first=Matthew |last=Travis |work=BallDurham.com |date=January 3, 2018 |accessdate=April 1, 2023}}</ref>

==Previous season==
The [[2016–17 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Blue Devils]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 28–9, 11–7 in [[2016–17 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in fifth place. They became the first ACC team to win four games in four days on their way to winning the [[2017 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]]. They received the ACC's automatic bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the East Region's #2 seed, where they defeated #15 [[2016–17 Troy Trojans men's basketball team|Troy]] in the first round before being upset by #7 [[2016–17 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team|South Carolina]] in the second round.
